description.p: KnightGambit is a premium, fully offline chess application for the GNOME desktop.

ul.li: Original Staunton-inspired vector pieces on a forest green and ivory board, sharp at every size
Complete official rules: castling, en passant, promotion, repetition, fifty and seventy-five move rules
Play Stockfish, Berserk, Ethereal, Koivisto or Leela Chess Zero at calibrated difficulty levels
Bullet, blitz, rapid, classical and custom clocks with increment and delay
Move history, game review, live engine analysis, PGN and FEN import and export

description.p: Move feedback: Stockfish can rate each move you play as brilliant, best, inaccuracy, mistake or blunder as you play.
Evaluation bar beside the board, and an analysis line: make your own moves after a game or during its review, with live feedback, without touching the real game.
Arrow tool: draw arrows and mark squares with the right mouse button; knight moves are drawn as an L.
Game History: every finished game against the computer is saved to a local database. Browse, search, filter and sort your games, replay them on a board, export PGN and back up the database.
Statistics & Analytics: interactive charts for results, openings, engine-verified move quality, and a strengths and weaknesses analysis with recommendations.
Wider sidebar that can be resized by dragging its left edge; the chosen width is remembered.
Stricter Game Review: accuracy now uses a harmonic and volatility-weighted average, material thrown away is always penalized, and blunders weigh much more on accuracy and estimated rating.
Game Review and live analysis now always use Stockfish at full strength.
New Book classification with an offline opening book and opening names, estimated game ratings, colored move list and a redesigned summary table.
Game Review with Brilliant, Great, Best, Excellent, Good, Forced, Inaccuracy, Mistake, Miss and Blunder classifications, accuracy scores, an evaluation graph and best-move arrows.
Premoves, redesigned pieces and support for custom SVG piece folders.
